name: CH America
old_description: Injection Molding Machines with Precision Performance and Energy Savings!
about:
CH America, based in Torrington, Connecticut, was formed as a joint venture between Plastics One of Torrington, CT, and Machinery International of Detroit, MI, to bring the Chen Hsong line of injection molding machines to the North American market. The company operates a 40,000-square-foot corporate office and warehouse in Torrington, supplemented by several warehousing locations nationwide.

CH America sells, services, and supports Chen Hsong injection molding machines, including the JM-MK6, SM DPV, Spark EH electric, SMV, Focus 60 SVP/2, and Supermaster two-platen servo-drive series, with clamping forces from 80 to 6,500 tons. The company also supplies auxiliary equipment such as robots, grinders, dryers, feeding and conveying systems, and chillers. An experienced engineering and service management team—four veterans with over 50 years of combined senior-management experience—handles machine start-up, preventive maintenance, and repair for all installed Chen Hsong machines across the U.S. and Canada.

The company serves the plastics injection molding industry, targeting molders and manufacturers seeking energy-efficient, high-performance machines. A testimonial from Mina Product Development Co. Inc. illustrates its customer base. CH America’s machines feature integrated hot-runner and valve-gate controls, gas-assist and accumulated injection capabilities, and specialized configurations for rigid UPVC production.

CH America differentiates itself with a fully customized in-house control system built on Beckhoff servo controllers, Industry 4.0 readiness via cloud-based monitoring and IoT connectivity, and stock machines available for inspection at its Torrington and Detroit facilities. The venture was created to provide local sales, service, and support for a global machine builder, combining Chinese manufacturing scale with North American service infrastructure.
